subject: Chiral perturbation theory (ChPT) quantitative prediction — positive effective calibration

source_ledger.claim: one-loop ChPT: pion mass relation m_pi^2 = M^2[1 - (M^2/F^2)(L-bar log M^2 + k_pi)] with L-bar = ln(mu^2/M^2)

provenance_map: prediction -> loop+counterterm computation -> LECs fixed from independent observables -> chiral symmetry (from QCD).
identifiability: Observable uniquely determined at declared order once LECs are fixed; truncation error estimated systematically.

effective_status: EFFECTIVE — with declared regime (M^2/(4 pi F)^2 << 1) and systematic truncation uncertainty.
